in_sanskrit.name: आर्यमान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The man who is worthy of worship, the one who is worthy of being revered, the noble one

in_hindi.name: अर्यमान
in_hindi.long_meaning: An enemy commander, a treasurer, a minister, a wealthy man, a man of prosperity

in_tamil.name: அறியமான
in_tamil.long_meaning: A wise man, a learned man, a man of knowledge, a man of intellect

in_telugu.name: అర్యమాన
in_telugu.long_meaning: A noble, an emperor, a king, a god

in_marathi.name: Aryaman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Aryan, man, god
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryaman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aryaman is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words ‘arya’ meaning noble or Aryan and ‘manav’ meaning man or mankind. This name signifies a noble and divine man, a god among men. In Hindu mythology, Aryaman is a god of hospitality, guests, and ancestors.

This name signifies a noble and divine man, a god among men. In Hindu mythology, Aryaman is a god of hospitality, guests, and ancestors.
